address: JW Marriott Grosvenor House London, Park Lane, Mayfair, London,W1K 7TN
bio: Bringing make-believe to Mayfair, Grosvenor House takes inspiration from the collection of 170 original drawings by Cicely Mary Barker and introduces an enchanting FLOWER FAIRIESTM Afternoon Tea. From the Flower Fairies of the Trees and Garden, Spring to Winter, each pastry pays homage to the enchanting narrative.  Offering the ultimate in British elegance, the Park Room brings a distinguished Afternoon Tea experience to the 5-star Grosvenor House. With a contemporary design and resident pianist, the Park Room offers a tranquil setting to relax away from busy London life.  With beautiful views overlooking the Royal Hyde Park, Park Room offers a seasonal twist on a traditional Afternoon Tea experience with delicate pastries hand crafted by the pastry team. A selection of Newby teas compliment the new Afternoon Tea alongside the option to add a glass of Champagne.  Since opening its doors in 1929, this serene retreat has been frequented by royalty, celebrities and business leaders.  Marble Arch Tube Station is a 6-minute walk away.  Afternoon Tea Awards 2019 - Highly Commended  Afternoon Tea is served daily from 13:00hrs to 18:00hrs.
